_comment: Common Ohio Revised Code criminal offenses. 'degree' is the default Ohio classification per the statute's most-applied subsection — actual degree depends on the subsection and aggravating factors. F1=Felony 1st (most serious), MM=Minor misdemeanor (least). Use as a best-guess severity label, not adjudication.
